title: Radical enzymatic peptide cyclization in natural product biosynthesis
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,2909-2958
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00585J, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ziwei Yao, Brandon I. Morinaka
Cyclic peptide natural products are privileged scaffolds in drug discovery. Here we review cyclization by radical enzymes which create diverse and unique macrocycles and comprise several distinct enzyme families.
